hero.heading: One day, eight talks, no filler
The conference for people who build
A day away from the backlog
Practitioners only. No keynotes for hire.
hero.subheading: A single track, deliberately. Everyone sees the same talks and argues about them afterwards.
Two hundred people, one room, and a long lunch on purpose.
Talks from people currently doing the work, not people who did it in 2015.
Friday 14 November, in the old print hall.

process.heading: How the day runs
process.subheading: Single track, so nobody has to choose.

process.steps.title: Arrive
process.steps.body: Doors and coffee from nine. Badges are on the table, find your own.

process.steps.title: Listen
process.steps.body: Four talks before lunch, three after. Twenty-five minutes each, questions after.

process.steps.title: Argue
process.steps.body: A long lunch and a closing panel, which is where the useful bits happen.
